description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

Closed-form edit-distance circuit: layer 0 attention gathers the 16 chars into slots and computes match bits; 15 MLP layers each run one Jacobi step of the 8x8 DP using thermometer (AND/shift) encoding; LayerNorm removed. Expected 100% accuracy.
Ablation of ThermoDP-v1 with only 14 DP (Jacobi) layers instead of 15; tests whether the T(8,8)=15 depth bound is needed for exact edit distance.
ThermoDP with 12 DP (Jacobi) layers instead of 15. An optimal alignment (cost <= 8) has at most 12 interior DP cells, so 12 steps should already be exact.
ThermoDP with 11 DP (Jacobi) layers, INF=8 start. Exact on the 200-sample harness; the later 20000-pair stress test (ThermoDP-d11-inf8) also gives 0 errors.
ThermoDP with 10 DP (Jacobi) layers. Probes how far the DP depth can be cut before optimal alignments with many interior cells are missed.
ThermoDP with 9 DP (Jacobi) layers. Depth sweep continues below the exactness bound.
ThermoDP with 8 DP (Jacobi) layers. Depth sweep: 8 steps just covers the all-diagonal path.

ThermoDP with 11 DP layers but interior cells initialised to 0 instead of INF=8. Still 100%: a walk from a zero-initialised interior cell must take exactly 11 steps, so it costs at least 8 and never beats the true distance.
ThermoDP with 10 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 0. Passes the 200-sample harness but has 11/20000 stress errors: at 10 steps, zero-initialised walks can cost 6 < true distance.
ThermoDP with 13 DP layers and zero-initialised interior cells. Extra depth beyond the exact bound should not change the answer.
ThermoDP with 7 DP layers and zero-initialised interior cells. Too shallow: the DP has not reached (8,8) for many inputs.
ThermoDP with 6 DP layers and zero-initialised interior cells. Too shallow for most inputs.
ThermoDP with 5 DP layers and zero-initialised interior cells. Too shallow for most inputs.
ThermoDP with 4 DP layers and zero-initialised interior cells. Too shallow for most inputs.
ThermoDP with 3 DP layers and zero-initialised interior cells. Too shallow for most inputs.
ThermoDP with 11 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 1. INF sweep at the exact depth.
ThermoDP with 11 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 2. INF sweep at the exact depth.
ThermoDP with 11 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 3. INF sweep at the exact depth.
ThermoDP with 11 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 4. INF sweep at the exact depth.
ThermoDP with 11 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 5. INF sweep at the exact depth.
ThermoDP with 10 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 1. Probes init sensitivity below the exact depth.
ThermoDP with 10 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 2. Probes init sensitivity below the exact depth.
ThermoDP (11 DP layers, zero init) with gather-head attention logit gap reduced from 30 to 3. Tests how sharp the gather attention must be.
ThermoDP (11 DP layers, zero init) with gather-head attention logit gap reduced from 30 to 6. Passes the 200-sample harness but has 28/20000 stress errors (soft attention leaks mass).
ThermoDP (11 DP layers, zero init) with gather-head attention logit gap set to 9 (base is 30).
ThermoDP (11 DP layers, zero init) with gather-head attention logit gap set to 7 (base is 30). Passes the 200-sample harness but has 5/20000 stress errors.
ThermoDP (11 DP layers, zero init) with gather-head attention logit gap set to 8 (base is 30).
Attempt to shrink MLP width d_ff 1536 -> 256 (assumed 192 units per DP layer; actually 64 cells x 8 thresholds x 3 units = 1536). IndexError at layer 0/DP write; reverted.
ThermoDP base construction (11 DP layers, zero init, attention logit 30) with the attention and DP settings restored after the attn sweep.
ThermoDP with 12 DP layers and zero-initialised interior cells, attention logit 30. Extra depth beyond the exact bound should not change the answer.

Ablation: ThermoDP base with the pass-through subtraction removed (fc2 weight on u3 set to 0). The old thermometer bit is no longer cancelled, so the DP state accumulates. Measured 0% (0/200; 19998/20000 wrong): every output saturates at 8.
ThermoDP with 15 DP layers (the full T(8,8) depth) and zero-initialised interior cells, attention logit 30. Over-deep relative to the 12-step bound; should stay exact.
ThermoDP with 11 DP layers and interior cells initialised to 8, the original INF value. Checks the INF sweep endpoint.

Ablation: ThermoDP base with the match bit removed from the diagonal AND (h1 ignores m). Measured 14% (28/200; 16854/20000 wrong): the diagonal move is taken whenever its neighbours allow it, so the min is wrong.
ThermoDP with 11 DP layers, zero init, and the smallest gather-attention logit that was exact (8). Minimal-sharpness version of the circuit.
ThermoDP with 9 DP layers, interior cells initialised to 8 (gather logit 8). Tests whether the INF=8 start still helps one step below depth 10.
ThermoDP with 10 DP layers, interior cells initialised to 8 (gather logit 8). Measured 0/20000 stress errors, unlike zero-init at depth 10 (11/20000).
ThermoDP with 12 DP layers, interior cells initialised to 8 (gather logit 8). Depth 12 with the INF=8 start, above the exact bound.
Ablation: ThermoDP (11 DP layers, zero init) with the DP boundary row/column set to 0 instead of D[0][j]=j and D[i][0]=i. Measured 62% (124/200; 7039/20000 wrong): the base cases are needed.
Final base construction: 11 DP layers, zero init, gather-attention logit 8, full boundary. Restored after the ablations; 0/20000 stress errors.
